install_package: install the LA-MCTS Python package using pip install from the setup.py configuration
build_package: build the LA-MCTS source distribution using python setup.py sdist
develop_install: install the LA-MCTS package in editable development mode using pip install -e
check_dependencies: check that all required dependencies from requirements.txt are satisfied for LA-MCTS
publish_package: publish the LA-MCTS package to PyPI using python setup.py sdist bdist_wheel upload
